Purpose: Stores simulated boiler drum water level in normalized engineering units (0.0% to 100.0%)
Expected Behavior: Modified by operator via Watch Table during simulation. Compared cyclically against Low_Level_Threshold.

Purpose: Configurable alarm setpoint for low drum water level detection
Expected Behavior: Operator-adjustable setpoint. Alarm activates if Water_Level drops strictly below this value.

Purpose: Discrete alarm indicator for boiler drum low water level condition
Expected Behavior: Evaluates to TRUE when Water_Level < Low_Level_Threshold; automatically resets to FALSE when Water_Level >= Low_Level_Threshold (non-latching).

Purpose: [Extended] Diagnostic flag for out-of-bounds simulated water level measurement
Expected Behavior: Evaluates to TRUE if Water_Level < 0.0 or Water_Level > 100.0. Does not clamp or alter raw input value.

Purpose: [Extended] Diagnostic flag for out-of-bounds low level threshold configuration
Expected Behavior: Evaluates to TRUE if Low_Level_Threshold < 0.0 or Low_Level_Threshold > 100.0.
